newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index plunges over 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Explorers Index plunges over 7 pct.

text.p: Perth stockbroker Eyres Reed Ltd said its Australian Explorers Index fell a sharp 7.09 percent in the week to Friday. The All Ordinaries Index dropped 2.2
Apr 4 Mar 28 pct 1 Month pct 1 Year pct
NOTE: The explorers index (base 500, March 1992) tracks the performance of 88 small capitalisation exploration companies.
The Eyres Reed Explorers Index fell sharply last week, off 250 points, confirming the end of an extended period of outperformance and continuing recent falls.
Only four companies in the explorers index managed positive moves for the week.
"Weakness in New York and Canadian sharemarkets sapped confidence from the 'spec' resource sector leaving it in a shaky state," Eyres Reed said.

Eyres Reed said the most notable gain was Titan Resources Ltd, up five cents to 36 cents following another strong nickel sulphide intersection 600 metres south of their previously reported, Goodyear nickel discovery, near Kambalda, Western Australia.
Falls were widespread, including Nugold Gold NL off three cents to 12 cents, Helix Resources NL down 30 cents to A$2.30 and Egerton Gold NL down four cents to 15 cents.
